port.name: bat · delta (tmTheme)
port.description: Living Code for bat · delta (tmTheme). Repository-owned theme files, installation instructions and four color flavors.

guide.installation:
**bat / delta**

```sh
curl -fsSL --create-dirs --output-dir "$(bat --config-dir)/themes" -O "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/living-code-theme/tmtheme/main/living-code-{night,frost,paper,signal}.tmTheme" && bat cache --build
bat --list-themes | grep living-code
```

Then `--theme="living-code-night"` in `$(bat --config-dir)/config`, and `syntax-theme = living-code-night` under `[delta]` in `~/.gitconfig`. For delta's diff backgrounds, headers and gutters, also use the dedicated [delta port](https://github.com/living-code-theme/delta).

**Sublime Text** has its own native color scheme: use the dedicated [Sublime Text port](https://github.com/living-code-theme/sublime). The `.tmTheme` files are kept for bat and delta.
guide.configuration: See [bat · delta (tmTheme)'s documentation](https://github.com/sharkdp/bat) for application settings and reload behavior. The activation instructions above identify each supported flavor; keep your other application configuration.
guide.compatibility: This port supplies theme files for bat · delta (tmTheme), not the application itself. Install the application separately and follow the installation instructions for its supported configuration format.
